clue.text: The best foundation for a plot

definitions.text: The best foundation for a plot

parts.words: The best foundation for a plot
parts.note: a plot here is a patch of garden ground, and the best base for growing blooms is a prepared bed of soil

explanation.surface: A writing tip about the strongest groundwork for a story's storyline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plot' reads as a novel's storyline, but it is a garden plot, whose ideal base is a bed for blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic description: the planted patch is literally what a garden plot is founded on.

clue.text: Government department alters text in introductions

parts.note: FO is the Foreign Office, a British ministry
to reword is to change the wording of a text

explanation.surface: A ministry edits the wording in the opening sections of its reports.
explanation.definitionFit: Prefaces at the front of books are synonyms for these opening pieces.

clue.text: Potential seed beginning one very unusual learning experience

indicators.note: beginning tells us to take the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A promising pupil starts out on a rare educational adventure.
explanation.definitionFit: In botany this structure in the ovary develops into a seed once fertilised.

clue.text: Flat ring provided for-performing with horses

parts.note: a flat surface is even, smooth and level
a ting is a light ringing sound

explanation.surface: A level arena is laid out for an equestrian display.
explanation.definitionFit: This equestrian sport combines dressage, cross-country and show jumping, so riders compete on horseback.

clue.text: Long shot certain to go over a railway

indicators.note: in a down clue, going over means sitting above the next pieces

parts.note: bound, as in 'bound to happen', means certain

explanation.surface: An outsider's bet is sure to pass across the train line.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a long hit reaching the rope at the edge of the field scores four or six runs.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket hit that reaches the field's edge is a big stroke, so a lofted drive scoring runs fits.

clue.text: It's a mistake to change sides

definitions.meaning: a flaw or fault in something
to desert one's country or party for the opposition

explanation.definitionFit: As a noun it means a fault; as a verb it means to abandon one side for the other.

clue.text: What witch may use to live — like this magic, primarily

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
so means in this way

indicators.note: primarily asks for the first letter of the word magic

explanation.surface: A witch's way of life, this kind of sorcery chiefly.
explanation.definitionFit: A broom made of twigs is the traditional transport of a witch in folklore.

clue.text: Ship -British one needing specialist engineers

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British army corps

explanation.surface: A British vessel requiring a team of skilled mechanics.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancient galley with two banks of oars is a type of vessel.

clue.text: Evidence about accomplished English ruler

indicators.note: about tells us the word for evidence goes around the other pieces

parts.note: a sign is evidence or an indication
over means done, finished or accomplished

explanation.surface: Proof concerning a skilled English monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch, king or queen, is the supreme ruler of a state.

clue.text: There has to be an R in the month, stupid!

indicators.note: in says the letter goes inside the word for the month

parts.note: a moon is a lunar month
the letter R as printed

explanation.surface: An exasperated reminder about months with R in them, as for eating oysters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stupid!' is a term of abuse addressed to someone, so it can stand for a noun calling them a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: Shouted at someone, 'stupid!' calls them an idiot, the same insult as this word.

clue.text: Decide to keep ring in gold coin holder

indicators.note: to keep means the word for decide holds the ring inside it

parts.note: to rule is to decide, as a judge does
O is ring-shaped
AU is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: Choosing to retain a gold ring inside a purse.
explanation.definitionFit: A cylindrical paper packet for a roll of coins is exactly a container for them.

clue.text: Warning cry's very short always

parts.note: fore is the golfer's shout warning of an incoming ball

indicators.note: short means the word very loses its final letter

parts.note: very taken as written before cutting

explanation.surface: A golfer's shout of warning is invariably clipped.
explanation.definitionFit: Eternally or for all time are synonyms of always.

clue.text: Question about Egyptian grain

indicators.note: about says the question word is wrapped around the other letter

parts.note: what is a question word
E is the abbreviation for Egyptian

explanation.surface: A query concerning Egyptian corn.
explanation.definitionFit: A cereal crop ground for flour is one of the commonest grains.

clue.text: What could make me read on, absorbing 100?

definitions.text: What could make me read on, absorbing 100?

indicators.note: absorbing means the anagrammed letters take in the numeral
what could make the clue words into something else signals a rearrangement

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for 100

explanation.surface: A gripping read that keeps me turning pages, taking in a hundred tales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What could make' turns ME READ ON into DEAMERON, and 'absorbing' puts C inside it. Boccaccio's book holds a hundred stories, so the whole clue describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Boccaccio's fourteenth-century collection of a hundred tales is a classic that keeps readers going.

clue.text: This may clarify what's crude about flashy clothes

parts.note: re means about or concerning
finery is showy, elaborate dress

explanation.surface: A remark explaining what's vulgar about gaudy outfits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crude' looks like a judgement on taste, but it is crude oil, which a plant purifies.
explanation.definitionFit: An industrial plant purifies crude oil or sugar into usable products.

clue.text: Definite last word on closure of pit? Heavens!

parts.note: firm means fixed or definite
amen is the final word of a prayer

indicators.note: closure of means the final letter of the word pit

explanation.surface: A firm final verdict on shutting a coal mine, met with an exclamation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heavens!' looks like an exclamation of surprise; it is the sky itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The vault of the sky is poetically the heavens.

clue.text: Indication of engaged status? Yes and no

definitions.text: Indication of engaged status? Yes and no

parts.words: Indication of engaged status? Yes and no
parts.note: a betrothal is shown by a band on the finger, yet a telephone tone of this kind shows the line is not busy

explanation.surface: A coy reply about whether someone is spoken for.
explanation.definitionFit: The band worn after a proposal marks betrothal, but the phone's trilling tone means the line is free.

clue.text: Verdant upland turned over to provide space for the rest of the players

definitions.text: space for the rest of the players

parts.note: verdant means green

indicators.note: turned over in a down clue means the word for upland is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a moor is open upland

explanation.surface: Lush high ground ploughed up to make a pitch for a team's off-duty members.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rest' and 'players' suggest sport, but they are actors resting offstage.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatre actors wait and relax in this backstage lounge when not on stage.

clue.text: Ambassador wrong to imprison monk for a week

parts.note: HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador

indicators.note: to imprison means the word for wrong encloses the monk

parts.note: bad means wrong
Dom is a title for a Benedictine monk

explanation.surface: A misguided envoy jails a monk for seven days.
explanation.definitionFit: A rare word for a period of seven days, from the Greek for seven.

clue.text: Short publication shows limit restricting speed at junction

indicators.note: restricting means the word for limit closes around the speed unit

parts.note: a pale is a boundary or limit, as in 'beyond the pale'
mph, miles per hour, is a measure of speed
a T-junction is shaped like the letter T

explanation.surface: A sign shows the speed limit at a road junction.
explanation.definitionFit: A booklet or leaflet is a brief printed work.

clue.text: Type that's abandoned Sally

indicators.note: abandoned means the letters for that is are dropped from the word for sally

parts.note: a sortie is a sally, a sudden attack by besieged troops
ie, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A kind of person who has dumped a woman called Sally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sally' looks like a woman's name; it is a military sortie.
explanation.definitionFit: A kind or variety is a synonym of type.

clue.text: Someone held a net I cast in river

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters inside the river

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain

indicators.note: cast suggests the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: An angler casts a net into a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' turns A NET I into TAINE, which goes inside DEE.
explanation.definitionFit: A prisoner kept in custody is a person held.

clue.text: You'll see ball-game in covering winter sports venue

indicators.note: in places the ball game inside the covering

parts.note: skin is an outer covering
RU is rugby union

explanation.surface: Where to watch ball games inside a winter resort.
explanation.definitionFit: A slope marked out for skiers is a place for winter sport.

clue.text: Replacement locks put on Western American lodge

parts.note: a wig is false hair replacing one's own locks

explanation.surface: A false hairpiece worn at a lodge in the American West.
explanation.definitionFit: A domed Native American dwelling is a kind of lodge.

clue.text: Comfort, perhaps, for Alcatraz inmate in dismal prison sentence

parts.note: black means gloomy or dismal
bird is British slang for time served in prison

explanation.surface: Solace for a convict in a grim jail term.
explanation.walkthrough: The Birdman of Alcatraz kept birds in prison, so a songbird might comfort an inmate there.
explanation.definitionFit: A songbird kept as company would be a solace to a prisoner like the famous Birdman.

clue.text: Consecrate bishop? Not so!

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
less means to a smaller degree, not so much

explanation.surface: A request to ordain a bishop is refused.
explanation.definitionFit: To sanctify or make holy is to consecrate.

clue.text: Power line carried by that support structure?

definitions.text: Power line carried by that support structure?

parts.words: Power line carried by that support structure?
parts.note: a tall steel tower holds overhead electricity cables aloft

explanation.surface: A question about what holds overhead cables.
explanation.definitionFit: The lattice towers that bear high-voltage cables across country are exactly such structures.

clue.text: Drunk, having taken on nearly two pints

parts.note: lit is slang for drunk
re means on or concerning

explanation.surface: A drinker who has downed almost a quart.
explanation.definitionFit: This metric measure of volume equals about 1.76 imperial pints.

clue.text: Part of face I declared almost tanned

indicators.note: declared means spoken out loud, signalling a word that sounds the same

parts.note: the pronoun I as printed

indicators.note: almost means the word for tanned loses its last letter

parts.note: brown means tanned by the sun

explanation.surface: A sunbather notes a bit of their face is nearly browned.
explanation.definitionFit: The arch of hair above the eye is a feature of the face.

clue.text: Greek character's total transformation as half-caste

parts.note: mu is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: transformation means the letters of total are changed in order

explanation.surface: A Greek person changes completely into one of mixed race.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated, now offensive term for a person of mixed Black and white parentage.

clue.text: Observed conference material

definitions.meaning: to attend a meeting as an onlooker

explanation.definitionFit: To sit in on a meeting is to observe it; the same letters name a lustrous cloth.

clue.text: I'm taken aback by vision about holy man in central Jordan, say

indicators.note: taken aback means read backwards, so the letters of I'm are turned round

parts.note: I'm without the apostrophe

indicators.note: about says the word for vision goes around the holy man

parts.note: a dream is a vision
St is short for saint

explanation.surface: Someone startled by a vision of a saint in the middle of the Jordan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jordan' is the river, so its centre is the middle of the stream, not the country.
explanation.definitionFit: The middle of a river's current is its centre, and the Jordan is an example of a river.
